findings.one_line: The proof replaces conditioning on the factual trajectory by conditioning only on E_t={R_t(x_t)=y_t}, but no stated assumption makes factual policy randomization independent of U_t (or R_t) given S_t; observed A_t can then reveal R_t and the induced posterior rows need not satisfy the p_t-capped fiber, invalidating the shared-interval route.
